'''Calum''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the [[Imperial Guard]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. From the [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] orbital station, he tasked a fellow Imperial with the mission of freeing the [[Dread Masters]] from [[The Tomb]].

He had a [[Duros]] [[Unidentified attache|attache]].<ref name="Riot on Belsavis" />
